text.p: Wheelabrator Technologies Inc said Monday it acquired from Simpson Paper Co a 42-megawatt, gas-fired cogeneration facilitiy. Terms were not disclosed.

The project, which will be named Wheelabrator Lassen Inc, is in Anderson, Calif., at Simpson's Shasta Mill. It has estimated annual revenues of about $14 million and is adjacent to an existing Wheelabrator biomass energy plant.
A current power purchase agreement between the facility and Pacific Gas and Electric Co will remain in effect for the next 17 years.

Process steam from the plant will be purchased by Simpson to operate its Shasta Mill. As part of the project, Wheelabrator also will construct a new steam line from its existing biomass plant in order to supply a portion of the steam to the Simpson mill.
